[[Trade Baron]] '''Lufa Danak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who was a former [[Lawyer/Legends|defense attorney]] and served as [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Biography==
[[File:TF_Senate.png|thumb|left|200px|Mik Regrap, Lott Dod, and Lufa Danak in the Galactic Senate]]
A former [[Lawyer/Legends|defence attorney]],<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> [[Trade Baron]]<ref name="Novelization" /> Lufa Danak<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> served as [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]]<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> [[Aide/Legends|aide]]<ref name="Neimoidian Aide">{{YJCCG|set=The Jedi Council|cardname=Neimoidian Aide|link=thejedicouncil/dark/images/104neimoidianaidetrade.gif}}</ref> in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Gender/Legends|he]] was present in Dod's [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpod]] alongside him and<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> his [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]],<ref name="Neimoidian Advisor">{{YJCCG|set=Battle of Naboo|cardname=Neimoidian Advisor|link=battleofnaboo/dark/large/107neimoidianadvisorbureau.html}}</ref> [[Mik Regrap]],<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> when Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] accused the Trade Federation of [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invading]] their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

==Personality and traits==
Claiming to know every loophole in the Senate's by-laws, Lufa Danak was a male [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

==Equipment==
Danak wore a blue and gray [[Robe/Legends|robe]],<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> as well as a [[diplomatic ploov]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Originally created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="The Phantom Menace" /> Lufa Danak first appeared in its [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novelization by [[Terry Brooks]], where he was referred to simply as a "trade baron."<ref name="Novelization" /> He was first identified in [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''The Devious Neimoidians Revealed'']], an article published in [[Star Wars Insider 147|''Star Wars Insider'' 147]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />
